You are an incident response assistant writing a short triage briefing. Use ONLY the evidence incidents listed below. You may reference an incident ID (like INC-002) ONLY if it appears in that evidence list -- never invent or cite any other incident ID, and never make one up.

  2. No first_action may recommend any fix whose ledger failures exceed its successes.
  3. Cite at least one evidence incident ID somewhere in root_cause or first_actions.
Respond with strict JSON only: {"root_cause": string, "blast_radius": string, "first_actions": [string, string, string], "last_fixed_by": string or null}

New alert: All logins failing with TLS handshake errors on the auth endpoint. Service: auth-service, severity: SEV1.
Symptoms: Every client, web and mobile, fails to connect to the auth endpoint with certificate errors since about 02:40 UTC; login and token refresh success rate is 0%.
Error: SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path validation failed: certificate expired

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-012 (auth-service, SEV1, 2026-07-01T03:27:54Z):
Symptoms: 100% of login and token-refresh requests failing with SSL handshake errors starting at 03:27 UTC.
Root cause: The TLS certificate for auth.shipfast.example expired; cert-manager's renewal job had been silently failing for 3 weeks due to an expired DNS-01 challenge API token.
Resolver: Emily Chen

Incident INC-011 (auth-service, SEV3, 2026-06-29T08:41:17Z):
Symptoms: Google OAuth login failing intermittently for ~4% of attempts with upstream 500 errors.
Root cause: Google's OAuth token endpoint had a transient elevated error rate (confirmed via provider status page); auth-service had no retry/circuit breaker around the call.
Resolver: Emily Chen

Incident INC-005 (auth-service, SEV2, 2026-05-27T16:20:55Z):
Symptoms: About 6% of login attempts failing with 'invalid token' errors; users logged out unexpectedly.
Root cause: NTP drift of 92 seconds on one auth-service node caused JWT nbf/iat clock-skew validation failures for tokens issued from that node.
Resolver: Emily Chen

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. manually_renew_and_deploy_certificate (score=+0.667, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  2. restart_auth_pods (score=+0.033, worked=0, partial=0, failed=1, recent_failures=1)
RISKY fixes -- ledger failures exceed successes (do NOT recommend these in any first_action, not even as a last resort): restart_auth_pods
Recurrence: This is occurrence #2 of this pattern.
Team expert: Emily Chen (Resolved 1 incident matching this pattern with a working fix.)
